***Milestones mark continued progress on the Company’s largest-ever order, a multi-year project announced in September 2026***


Rehovot, Israel, Nov. 24, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global leader in edge computing, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and video intelligence solutions for defense applications, today announced that it has successfully completed the initial milestones under the airborne video systems order for multiple next-generation manned airborne platforms that was previously announced on September 28, 2026.


The completed milestones, in the aggregate, represent a contractual value of approximately US$633,000.


As previously announced, Maris-Tech received its largest-ever order, valued at approximately US$10 million, to develop and supply advanced video systems for multiple next-generation manned airborne platforms. The order is part of a multi-year project being carried out in collaboration with Magam Safety Ltd. (“Magam”).


Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech, commented: “We believe the successful completion of the initial milestones marks an important step forward in this multi-year project. The project is progressing in line with our plans, and we look forward to continuing our work with Magam on the development and supply of these advanced video systems.”


Maris-Tech expects to complete deliveries representing approximately US$7.1 million of the order value by the end of 2028.


**About Maris-Tech Ltd.**


Maris-Tech delivers AI-powered edge video solutions for mission-critical defense and security operations, enabling real-time situational awareness, intelligence gathering, and surveillance in bandwidth- and latency-constrained environments. Trusted by leading security organizations, Maris-Tech platforms are deployed across UAVs, UGVs, armored vehicles, and dismounted soldier systems, supporting missions that require ultra-low-latency video processing and onboard AI analytics. From intelligence collection in extreme conditions to AI-driven surveillance and terrain dominance, Maris-Tech masters the AI video pipeline at the edge through best-in-class SWaP-optimized, ruggedized computing solutions.
